text:
maya: Heads up 00: spotted repeated thermal spikes in eu-west racks causing eviction cascades. Thinking about proactive quarantine instead of reactive handoffs.

infra-bot: ALERT: gpu_temp_spike detected rack-eu-west-12 @ 4891234550 14% eviction rate last 10m

alex: Can you share the query used to find tenants? want per-tenant view.

maya: Quick grafana snippet: ```SELECT tenant, count(eviction) as evictions, max(gpu_temp) as peak_temp FROM infra.events WHERE time > now() - 30m GROUP BY tenant ORDER BY evictions DESC LIMIT 20;```

sam: Proposal: when tenant hits threshold (evictions or sustained temp), move them to a short-lived dedicated "quarantine" warm slice for 5-15m. That avoids repeated handoffs and KV-cache churn. Cost = burst reserve.

linh: How do we size slices and avoid penalizing bursty but benign tenants?

naomi: Pair quarantine with routing to a quantized fallback model variant plus egress crediting; auto-notify tenant ops contact. Keep enterprise tiers on safer path.

alex: PR checklist: detection signal + window, quarantine allocation flow, warm-slice drain policy (cache snapshot), ttl/extension rules, billing metadata tag, region caps and rollback. Also provenance id on allocations.

maya: Draft thresholds: condition A: evictions >= 5 in 10m OR evictions spike >= 300% vs baseline; condition B: GPU temp > 85C for >= 3 consecutive 1m samples -> action: create quarantine slice ttl 10m, route traffic, apply quantized fallback, tag billing "noisy_quarantine:thermal".

sam: I'll run a 7-day placement replay on k8s-sim to estimate cost delta and eviction reduction.

linh: Edge-case: cross-rack NVLink tenants causing correlated thermal events. Add cross-host correlation check before quarantine to avoid oscillation.

naomi: I'll draft customer comms explaining quarantine, expected duration, and review request path; add billing note.

alex: Routing tweak: prefer dedicated fallback + quantized bins for quarantined tenants; for latency-critical enterprise tenants, use token caps instead. Add alert if quarantine_count in region > 5.

maya: I'll emit an infra-bot event when threshold met and include provenance id; infra-bot will call allocation API.

infra-bot: RUNBOOK-CMD: quarantine-create --tenant $TENANT --region eu-west --ttl 10m --size small --reason "therm-noise-evict" --tags noisy_quarantine --provenance $ID

sam: Schedule: prototyping session tomorrow 10:30am PT to prototype replay + infra-bot hook. Also log cost delta per quarantine on dashboard.

maya: Adding dashboard tiles: quarantine_count_by_region, spare_cost_usd_per_quarantine_hr, evictions_pre_vs_post.

infra-bot: ACTIONS CREATED: [#1 run replay (sam)], [#2 policy PR (maya)], [#3 routing change (alex)], [#4 dashboard tile (maya)], [#5 comms draft (naomi)].

linh: Thanks all. Keep thresholds conservative for canary.

maya: TL;DR: detect noisy thermal patterns -> quarantine short-lived warm slices -> route to quantized fallback -> monitor cost & customer impact -> iterate.

infra-bot: MONITOR: canary.monitor.quarantine.count > 5 -> page #eng-oncall
